mapper.select: SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.zip_no, f.province_name, f.city_name, f.address, f.tel_no, f.main_sport, ST_Y(f.location) as latitude, ST_X(f.location) as longitude, COALESCE(AVG(r.rating), 0) as aver_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) as review_count FROM facilities f LEFT JOIN review r ON f.facility_id = r.facility_id WHERE f.facility_id = #{facilityId} GROUP BY f.facility_id

SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.zip_no, f.province_name, f.city_name, f.address, f.tel_no, f.main_sport, ST_Y(f.location) as latitude, ST_X(f.location) as longitude, COALESCE(AVG(r.rating), 0) as aver_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) as review_count FROM facilities f LEFT JOIN review r ON f.facility_id = r.facility_id GROUP BY f.facility_id ORDER BY f.facility_id DESC LIMIT #{page.limit} OFFSET #{page.offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE facilities SET aver_rating = #{averRating} WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}

where.if: AND ( f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.main_sport LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

if.test: radius != null and lat != null and lng != null

mapper.select:
SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.zip_no, f.province_name, f.city_name, f.address, f.tel_no, f.main_sport, ST_Y(f.location) as latitude, ST_X(f.location) as longitude, COALESCE(AVG(r.rating), 0) as aver_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) as review_count
, ST_Distance_Sphere( f.location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{lng}, ' ', #{lat}, ')'), 4326) ) as distance
FROM facilities f LEFT JOIN review r ON f.facility_id = r.facility_id
GROUP BY f.facility_id
ORDER BY distance ASC
ORDER BY f.name ASC
ORDER BY aver_rating DESC, f.facility_id DESC
LIMIT #{pagination.limit} OFFSET #{pagination.offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.facility_id) FROM facilities f LEFT JOIN review r ON f.facility_id = r.facility_id
SELECT DISTINCT province_name FROM facilities WHERE province_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY province_name
SELECT DISTINCT city_name FROM facilities WHERE province_name = #{province} AND city_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY city_name
SELECT DISTINCT main_sport FROM facilities WHERE main_sport IS NOT NULL ORDER BY main_sport

SELECT facilities.facility_id, facilities.name, facilities.tel_no, facilities.main_sport, facilities.address, COALESCE(AVG(rating),0) as aver_rating, COUNT(favorite_id) as favorite_count FROM facilities LEFT JOIN favorite_facility on facilities.facility_id = favorite_facility.facility_id LEFT JOIN review on facilities.facility_id = review.facility_id GROUP BY facilities.facility_id ORDER BY favorite_count DESC LIMIT 3;
